items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: He used to play with Blanche Calloway.

ctx.x: But all that Louis influence, and so many beautiful guys I knew around here, even guys that didn't play with the biggest of bands, you know. There was a guy around here named Mason once. He used to play with Blanche Calloway. He was a great trumpet player. And Peanuts was a great trumpet player too.
